text: Škoda Auto's sole shareholder is Volkswagen Finance Luxemburg S.A., whose sole shareholder is Volkswagen AG; Volkswagen AG, as parent company, holds direct or indirect interests in Škoda Auto a.s.

source.name: Škoda Auto Company (skoda-auto.com)
source.quote: Škoda Auto has a sole shareholder, a General Meeting is not held and its powers are executed by this sole shareholder: VOLKSWAGEN FINANCE LUXEMBURG S.A. with its registered seat in Luxembourg, the Grand Duchy of Luxembourg.

additionalSources.name: Škoda Annual Report 2025: Corporate Governance
additionalSources.quote: The sole shareholder of VOLKSWAGEN FINANCE LUXEMBURG S.A. is VOLKSWAGEN AKTIENGESELLSCHAFT (“VW AG”), having its registered office in Wolfsburg, Federal Republic of Germany.

additionalSources.name: Volkswagen Group Annual Report 2025: Structure and Business Activities
additionalSources.quote: In its capacity as parent company, Volkswagen AG holds direct or indirect interests in AUDI AG, SEAT S.A., Škoda Auto a.s.
